thesis: The podcast discusses the evolution of the quantitative landscape over the last 20 years, noting that the bar for investment strategies has continuously risen as market inefficiencies are exploited. Consequently, the shelf life of strategies has shortened, requiring constant evolution, more data, and more processing power to maintain an edge.
